description:

Measured against the ceilings: largest drive 35816 vs 35200 (+616), total requests 36112 vs 35496 (+616), derivations 16743 vs 16383 (+360), reads 122439 vs 118770 (+3669), drives 25 vs 25.

Cause: #903 (fz-sc8.22.3, aae3f942b) merged before #897 (fz-mue.28, a3dd6e8c7). #897 lowered the ceilings to counts measured without #903's user-accepted cost (+412 largest drive, +219 derivations, +2,732 reads). The remainder (+204 / +141 / +937) comes from another merge in aae3f942b..cd18bf4ab; the follow-up ticket attributes it.

Done when: tests/distill_telemetry_test.rs ceilings equal develop's measured counts at the tip this lands on (re-measure on that tip), and develop CI is green.
